gripOrHq.title: Off-Site Backups
gripOrHq.rulesText: Bring any card from the Archives into HQ.

gripOrHq.title: Ice Transmutation
gripOrHq.rulesText: Choose a piece of rezzed ice when you score Ice Transmutation. That ice now has +1 strength, and each subroutine on it is repeated once. Treat this as if each repeated subroutine appeared immediately after the original subroutine.

gripOrHq.title: Ice Transmutation
gripOrHq.rulesText: Choose a piece of rezzed ice when you score Ice Transmutation. That ice now has +1 strength, and each subroutine on it is repeated once. Treat this as if each repeated subroutine appeared immediately after the original subroutine.

gripOrHq.title: AI Chief Financial Officer
gripOrHq.rulesText: A: Shuffle cards stored in HQ and the Archives into R&D; then draw five cards.

heapOrArchives.title: Corporate Negotiating Center
heapOrArchives.rulesText: At the start of each of your turns, gain [1] for each agenda card stored in HQ that you show to Runner.

rig.title: Crash Space
rig.rulesText: Gain [1] at the start of each of your turns. All trace attempts are automatically successful, and give you a tag in addition to their other effects. If Crash Space leaves play, lose [2]. A: Trash Crash Space. Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

ice.title: Ball and Chain
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, Runner must pay [2] when encountering a piece of ice, in addition to any other costs, or end the run.

root.title: Rio de Janeiro City Grid
root.rulesText:
Roll a die whenever Runner passes a piece of rezzed ice during a run on this fort. On a 1, end the run.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

root.title: Olivia Salazar
root.rulesText: For half cost, rounded down, rez a piece of ice installed on this fort. Derez that ice at the end of the run. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.

root.title: Corporate Negotiating Center
root.rulesText: At the start of each of your turns, gain [1] for each agenda card stored in HQ that you show to Runner.
